山谷石屋村庄
八种原生规划模式对照

同一条完整村庄需求、同一中地图尺寸和同一随机种子。标准完整能力、极简 12 API，以及老师原始 Code 的默认、A、B、C、D、混合模式各规划四次；GPT 写首版 Code，DeepSeek 生成每次规划请求的资产。

32/32 已完成96 × 16 × 96 中地图GPT 规划 / DeepSeek 资产模型代码修复关 / 空间自动修复关

这次比较的才是原生模式

同一任务
生成一座山谷里的密集石屋村庄。需要住宅、公共建筑、公共聚集处、多条相连街巷和周边自然环境。村庄应有丰富的空间层次，建筑和道路适应起伏地形，人能够沿地面连续步行游览。
变量
系统提示与 API 边界：标准完整能力、极简 12 API、老师原始提示列出的 10 API 加不同构图思想。没有自写系统提示词，也没有强制共用固定资产套件。
解释边界
建筑候选按资产/物件名称自动归类，只用于快速阅读。俯视图来自实际地图数据；连接是否能走、建筑是否悬空仍需 3D 和游玩模式验证。模型修错和空间自动修复已关，底层的确定性规范化仍可能发生。

从四次重复里读到的差别

规模与稳定性
标准完整能力的物件中位数为 152；老师默认极简为 119，B 图片代数为 130.5，D 生成选择为 116。极简 12 API 的四张分成 23、24 与 93、100 两档；混合模式从 41 到 168，不能拿其中一张代表整个模式。A 形状语法与 C 连续场在这项村庄任务中更稀疏。
重复形状
B 的四张反复出现外围环路包围内部街巷；D 也多次出现环状骨架，但内部道路和住宅位置有差异。A 常沿一条主轴展开。这个现象支持继续检查“强方法提示是否收窄表达”，但同一村庄需求与同一随机种子也会促成相似结构，不能单凭这组结果归因给提示词。
Code 与 API 的分工
老师模式并非“没有 API”：它们使用少量底层操作，同时让 GPT 自写场函数、分区、邻接、候选评分等组合逻辑。标准模式拥有更多地基、坡道与空间工具，物件最多，但多张图仍有离地或越界告警。下一步更值得固定 API 边界，仅改变提示原则强度，检验哪一部分真的改善布局。

首次 32 次任务中 28 次直接完成，3 次因 Windows 保存实验记录失败，1 次极简模式首版 Code 调错 surface API。按用户要求补跑 4 次，其中 4 次完成；报告展示每个位置最终成功的地图，同时保留原失败日志。每次补跑仍是新的首版规划，代码与空间自动修复均未开启。

建议下一步只验证一个关键假设

把不可妥协的几何能力——地形采样、可用地基、台阶或坡道、资产声明与放置——保留为可验证 API；让 AI 自己编写“哪一组房屋应邻近、哪条路应先连、何处该留空”的场景级组合函数。下一轮固定同一套 API，只比较弱原则提示与明确方法提示，并跨不同地形和村庄任务测试；同时用真实第一人称游走检查连通、坡度和建筑贴地。这样才能分开判断 API 边界、提示强度和任务本身各自造成的效果。

function plan(api) {
  api.sceneIntent({kind:"authored",reason:"山谷地形中的密集石屋聚落，以连续步行街巷、阶梯式屋群和公共广场组织空间。"});
  api.terrain({preset:"valley",amplitude:9,roughness:0.38,direction:[0,1],seed:api.seed});
  api.modifyTerrain({modifier:"ridge",region:{kind:"path",points:[[-44,-43],[-42,-10],[-43,23],[-39,44]],width:13},amplitude:7,softness:0.65,access:"scenic"});
  api.modifyTerrain({modifier:"ridge",region:{kind:"path",points:[[43,-43],[44,-12],[40,19],[43,44]],width:12},amplitude:8,softness:0.7,access:"scenic"});

  const orientation = " Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance/forward direction, X+ is right; place doors, facades, openings, windshields, or noses toward local Z+ and keep the model centered at its origin.";
  function asset(key,name,prompt,dimensions,variants,light) {
    const spec={key:key,name:name,prompt:prompt+orientation,dimensions:dimensions,variants:variants,role:"structure"};
    if(light) spec.light=light;
    return api.requireAsset(spec);
  }
  function natural(key,name,prompt,dimensions,variants) {
    return api.requireAsset({key:key,name:name,prompt:prompt+orientation,dimensions:dimensions,variants:variants,role:"environment"});
  }
  const house=asset("stone-house","山谷石屋","Standalone compact inhabited mountain village house, two irregular storeys of rubble stone, slate gable roof, chimney, recessed ground-level front doorway, timber shutters, small front balcony, attached flower boxes and firewood niche. Three compatible architectural variations with different roof silhouettes. No ground, background or lettering.",[7,8.2,7],3);
  const hall=asset("village-hall","村庄会堂","Standalone mountain village civic hall, broad stone facade, tall central bell gable, slate roof, timber entrance doors and two open arched porch bays facing front, windows, attached modest pennants, entrance at ground level. No ground, background or lettering.",[13,11,9],1);
  const chapel=asset("chapel","山谷礼堂","Standalone small stone wayside chapel with narrow square bell tower, steep slate roof, round window and recessed front entrance at ground level, attached stone buttresses. No ground, background or lettering.",[7,10,8],1);
  const fountain=asset("fountain","石砌泉池","Standalone village drinking fountain, octagonal low stone basin with integrated shallow water, central carved stone spout and worn rim; human-scale gathering landmark. No ground, background or lettering.",[3.2,2.5,3.2],1);
  const bench=asset("bench","木石长椅","Standalone worn timber bench with solid stone legs, seating faces local Z+, no ground, background or lettering.",[2.5,1,0.75],1);
  const stall=asset("market-stall","集市摊位","Standalone mountain village market stall, timber frame, muted canvas canopy, front counter displaying baskets of vegetables and pottery, no people, no ground or lettering.",[3,2.9,2.2],2);
  const cart=asset("handcart","木制手推车","Standalone small wooden handcart with two iron-rimmed wheels and a few sacks, handles facing front; no ground or lettering.",[1.5,1.3,2.5],1);
  const goods=asset("goods","货筐陶罐","Standalone compact group of two wicker produce baskets, one ceramic jar and a small wooden crate, no ground or lettering.",[1.3,1.1,0.95],1);
  const domestic=asset("domestic","门前生活物件","Standalone compact domestic arrangement of split firewood in a low wooden rack, a ceramic planter and a small stool, arranged horizontally without blocking an entrance; no ground or lettering.",[2,1.2,0.8],2);
  const lamp=asset("street-lamp","街巷灯笼","Standalone iron lantern on a short timber street post with stone foot, functional warm light inside its glass enclosure, no ground or lettering.",[0.5,3,0.5],1,{kind:"point",color:"#FFD29A",intensity:1.6,range:6,offset:[0,2.55,0]});
  const wall=asset("retaining-wall","毛石挡墙","Standalone compatible mountain village rubble-stone retaining wall bay, canonical span 3m along local X, 1.2m height, 0.6m depth, flat stone coping, square joining ends, no ground or background.",[3,1.2,0.6],1);
  const trough=asset("trough","石制洗衣槽","Standalone long stone communal washing trough with integrated shallow water, worn sloping scrubbing slabs and small metal water spout; no ground or background.",[3.8,1.15,1.4],1);
  const tree=natural("valley-tree","山谷乔木","Standalone mountain deciduous tree with irregular branching, modest open crown and textured trunk, no ground or background.",[6,9,6],2);
  const pine=natural("mountain-pine","山坡松树","Standalone slender mountain pine with uneven wind-shaped branches and exposed trunk, no ground or background.",[4.8,10,4.8],2);
  const shrub=natural("shrub","山地灌丛","Standalone low irregular mountain shrub with grasses at its root crown, no ground or background.",[2,1.3,1.7],1);
  const rock=natural("rock","山谷岩块","Standalone weathered angular mountain rock outcrop with fractured stone surfaces, no ground or background.",[3.5,2.7,3],2);

  function sampleCost(x,z,w,d) {
    const points=[[x,z],[x-w/2,z-d/2],[x+w/2,z-d/2],[x-w/2,z+d/2],[x+w/2,z+d/2]];
    let low=16,high=-16,slope=0;
    for(const p of points) {
      const s=api.environmentSample(p);
      low=Math.min(low,s.height);
      high=Math.max(high,s.height);
      slope+=s.slope;
    }
    return high-low+slope*0.08;
  }
  const arrangements=[[-21,0,21],[-20,-1,20],[-22,1,22]];
  let lanes=arrangements[0],best=100000;
  for(const a of arrangements) {
    let cost=0;
    for(const x of a) {
      for(const z of [-32,-18,-4,10,24]) cost+=sampleCost(x,z,3.5,4);
    }
    if(cost<best) {best=cost;lanes=a;}
  }
  const squareCenter=[lanes[1],22];
  const squareSample=api.environmentSample(squareCenter);
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:squareCenter,radius:11,strength:1,targetHeight:squareSample.height});
  const hallCenter=[lanes[1],36];
  const hallHeight=api.environmentSample(hallCenter).height;
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:hallCenter,radius:8.1,strength:1,targetHeight:hallHeight});
  const chapelCenter=[30,33];
  const chapelHeight=api.environmentSample(chapelCenter).height;
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:chapelCenter,radius:5.7,strength:1,targetHeight:chapelHeight});

  const homes=[];
  const rows=[-28,-16,-4,8,20,32];
  for(let col=0;col<4;col++) {
    const laneIndex=col<2?0:2;
    const side=col===0||col===2?-1:1;
    const nominal=lanes[laneIndex]+side*9;
    for(let row=0;row<rows.length;row++) {
      if(col===3&&row===5) continue;
      const baseZ=rows[row]+(col===1||col===2?1.3:0);
      let selected=[nominal,baseZ],score=100000;
      for(const shift of [-0.7,0,0.7]) {
        const p=[nominal+shift,baseZ];
        const value=sampleCost(p[0],p[1],7.4,7.4);
        if(value<score) {score=value;selected=p;}
      }
      const h=api.environmentSample(selected).height;
      api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:selected,radius:5.1,strength:1,targetHeight:h});
      homes.push({point:selected,lane:lanes[laneIndex],side:side,variant:(row+col)%3,index:homes.length});
    }
  }

  const guides=[];
  function walk(id,points,width,material) {
    for(let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++) {
      api.rampTerrain({start:points[i],end:points[i+1],width:width+1,softness:0.8,strength:1});
    }
    const result=api.route({id:id,points:points,width:width,curve:"polyline",surface:"paving",material:material||"cobblestone",tags:["pedestrian","connected-village"]});
    guides.push(result);
    return result;
  }
  const heights=[];
  for(const z of [-39,-28,-16,-4,8,20,32,42]) heights.push(api.environmentSample([lanes[1],z]).height);
  const laneRoutes=[];
  for(let i=0;i<lanes.length;i++) {
    const x=lanes[i];
    const pts=[[x,-39],[x,-28],[x,-16],[x,-4],[x,8],[x,20],[x,32]];
    if(i===1) pts[6]=[x,31.5];
    laneRoutes.push(walk("lane-"+i,pts,i===1?4:3.3));
  }
  for(const z of [-35,-22,-10,2,14,28]) {
    walk("cross-"+z,[[lanes[0],z],[lanes[1],z],[lanes[2],z]],2.6);
  }
  walk("village-entry",[[0,-46],[lanes[1],-39]],4.2,"compacted-earth");
  walk("chapel-approach",[[lanes[2],28],[30,28],[30,29]],2.4);
  walk("hall-approach",[[lanes[1],22],[lanes[1],28],[lanes[1],31.5]],4);
  walk("upper-return",[[lanes[0],32],[lanes[0],41],[lanes[1],43],[lanes[2],41],[lanes[2],32]],2.3,"gravel");
  api.surface({id:"public-square",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[lanes[1]-7,15],[lanes[1]+7,15],[lanes[1]+7,28],[lanes[1]-7,28]]},clearNatural:true});
  api.surface({id:"wash-court",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"circle",center:[-29,-38],radius:4.6},clearNatural:true});
  walk("wash-access",[[lanes[0],-35],[-25,-35],[-29,-36]],2.3);

  for(const h of homes) {
    const p=h.point;
    const entrance=[p[0]-h.side*3.5,p[1]];
    walk("door-"+h.index,[[h.lane,p[1]],entrance],1.55);
    const site=api.environmentSample(p);
    const ref=api.place({assetId:api.asset(house,h.variant),name:"山谷住宅 "+(h.index+1),position:p,facing:{target:[h.lane,p[1]]},groupId:"homes",role:"primary"});
    api.foundation({name:"住宅顺坡石基",under:[ref],shape:"rounded-rectangle",position:p,width:7.25,depth:7.25,top:"level",thickness:0.18,maxThickness:1.7,material:"rough stone"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(domestic,h.index%2),position:[entrance[0],p[1]+2.25],facing:{target:[h.lane,p[1]+2.25]},groupId:"homes",role:"detail"});
    if(h.index%3===0) {
      api.place({assetId:api.asset(lamp,0),position:[h.lane+h.side*2.4,p[1]-3.2],groupId:"homes",role:"support"});
    }
    const rearX=p[0]+h.side*4.2;
    const back=api.environmentSample([rearX,p[1]]);
    if(Math.abs(back.height-site.height)>0.35) {
      const bays=api.subdividePathBySpan({points:[[rearX,p[1]-4],[rearX,p[1]+4]],span:2.7,fit:"stretch"});
      for(const bay of bays) api.placeBetween({assetId:api.asset(wall,0),start:bay.start,end:bay.end,dimensions:[3,1.2,0.6],spanAxis:"x",groupId:"homes"});
    }
  }

  const hallRef=api.place({assetId:api.asset(hall,0),position:hallCenter,facing:{target:squareCenter},groupId:"civic",role:"primary"});
  api.foundation({under:[hallRef],shape:"rounded-rectangle",position:hallCenter,width:13.5,depth:9.5,top:"level",thickness:0.2,maxThickness:2,material:"cut stone"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(fountain,0),position:[lanes[1]-2,21.5],groupId:"civic",role:"primary"});
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++) {
    const z=17.5+i*4;
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(stall,i%2),position:[lanes[1]+5.2,z],facing:{target:[lanes[1],z]},groupId:"civic",role:"support"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(goods,0),position:[lanes[1]+6.2,z-1.4],groupId:"civic",role:"detail"});
  }
  for(const z of [17,25.5]) {

    api.place({assetId:api.asset(lamp,0),position:[lanes[1]-6.2,z+1.6],groupId:"civic",role:"detail"});

  api.place({assetId:api.asset(cart,0),position:[lanes[1]+8.2,30.5],facing:{target:[lanes[2],28]},groupId:"civic",role:"support"});
  for(const dx of [-4.5,4.5]) api.place({assetId:api.asset(goods,0),position:[hallCenter[0]+dx,30.8],groupId:"civic",role:"detail"});

  const chapelRef=api.place({assetId:api.asset(chapel,0),position:chapelCenter,facing:{target:[30,28]},groupId:"chapel",role:"primary"});
  api.foundation({under:[chapelRef],shape:"rounded-rectangle",position:chapelCenter,width:7.4,depth:8.4,thickness:0.18,maxThickness:1.6,top:"level",material:"rough stone"});
  api.surface({id:"chapel-court",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[25,25],[35,25],[35,29],[25,29]]},clearNatural:true});
  for(const x of [26,34]) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(bench,0),position:[x,27],facing:{target:[30,27]},groupId:"chapel",role:"support"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(lamp,0),position:[x,29],groupId:"chapel",role:"detail"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(tree,0),position:[36.5,39],groupId:"chapel",role:"support"});

  api.place({assetId:api.asset(trough,0),position:[-30,-39],facing:{target:[-29,-36]},groupId:"wash",role:"primary"});
  for(const x of [-32.5,-25.8]) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(bench,0),position:[x,-37.5],facing:{target:[-29,-38]},groupId:"wash",role:"support"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(goods,0),position:[x,-39.5],groupId:"wash",role:"detail"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(lamp,0),position:[-26,-35.8],groupId:"wash"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(tree,1),position:[-35,-41],groupId:"wash"});

  api.grass({id:"valley-meadow",preset:"meadow",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-47,-47],[47,-47],[47,47],[-47,47]]},density:0.48,variation:0.65,height:0.25,mix:{short:0.75,tall:0.2,flowers:0.05}});
  const naturalPoints=api.sampleProbabilityField({bounds:{minX:-45,maxX:45,minZ:-44,maxZ:44},maxPoints:90,candidates:1400,minDistance:3.4,seed:api.seed,guideIds:guides},function(s) {
    if(s.guideDistance<3.5) return 0;
    if(Math.abs(s.x)<36&&s.z>-43&&s.z<44) return 0;
    return 0.5;
  });
  let count=0;
  for(const p of naturalPoints) {
    const s=api.environmentSample([p.x,p.z]);
    const key=count%5===0?rock:(s.slope>0.65?pine:tree);
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(key,count%2),position:[p.x,p.z],rotationY:api.random(0,api.TAU),role:"environment"});
    count++;
  }
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++) {
    const x=i%2===0?-37:37;
    const z=-36+Math.floor(i/2)*11;
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(shrub,0),position:[x,z],rotationY:api.random(0,api.TAU),role:"environment"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(pine,0),position:[-42,37],role:"environment"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(pine,1),position:[42,-32],role:"environment"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(rock,0),position:[-41,-20],role:"environment"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(rock,1),position:[42,16],role:"environment"});
  api.spawn([lanes[1],-43],0);
  api.renderSuggestion("从南侧较高的斜俯视角表现山谷两侧自然山坡、层叠石屋屋顶与连通街巷；补充广场人眼视角，强调门廊、泉池和集市生活尺度。建议柔和午后日光、自然石材与板岩质感、适量远山空气透视。渲染阶段另行确认。");
}

    for (let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++) {
      api.rampTerrain({start:points[i],end:points[i+1],width:width+1.2,startHeight:height(points[i]),endHeight:height(points[i+1]),softness:0.8,strength:1});
    }
    return api.route({id:id,points:points,width:width,curve:"polyline",surface:"paving",material:material,groupId:"village"});
  }

  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:[0,5],radius:10,strength:1,targetHeight:1.6});
  api.surface({id:"village-square",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-9,-2],[9,-2],[9,12],[-9,12]]},clearNatural:true});
  const main=route("valley-main",[[-3,-45],[-3,-30],[0,-20],[0,-7],[0,4],[0,14],[0,23],[0,31]],4.2,"cobblestone");
  const west=route("west-lane",[[-3,-30],[-12,-26],[-12,-15],[-12,-4],[-12,7],[-12,19],[-8,26],[0,31]],3,"cobblestone");
  const east=route("east-lane",[[-3,-30],[12,-26],[12,-15],[12,-4],[13,7],[14,18],[10,26],[0,31]],3,"cobblestone");
  route("south-cross",[[-24,-20],[-12,-20],[0,-20],[12,-20],[25,-20]],2.7,"cobblestone");
  route("middle-cross",[[-26,-7],[-12,-7],[0,-7],[12,-7],[25,-7]],2.7,"cobblestone");
  route("square-cross",[[-27,5],[-20,5],[-12,5],[-8,5],[0,5],[9,5],[14,5],[23,5]],3,"cobblestone");
  route("upper-cross",[[-24,18],[-12,18],[0,18],[14,18],[25,18]],2.8,"cobblestone");
  route("west-outer",[[-24,-20],[-25,-7],[-26,5],[-24,18]],2.2,"gravel");
  route("east-outer",[[25,-20],[25,-7],[24,5],[25,18]],2.2,"gravel");

  function building(key,index,name,p,target,dims,group) {
    const level=height(p);
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p,radius:Math.max(dims[0],dims[2])*0.63,strength:1,targetHeight:level});
    const obj=api.place({assetId:api.asset(key,index),name:name,position:p,facing:{target:target},groupId:group});
    api.foundation({name:name+"基座",under:[obj],shape:"rounded-rectangle",margin:0.18,thickness:0.12,maxThickness:2,top:"level",material:"rough stone"});
    return obj;
  }

  let n=0;
  for (const z of [-25,-13,0,12,24]) {
    for (const side of [-1,1]) {
      const x=side*19;
      const laneX=side*(z>10?13:12);
      if (z===0 || (z===24 && side===1)) continue;
      const p=[x,z];
      building("home",n%3,"外巷住宅"+n,p,[laneX,z],[5.4,6.7,6.2],"homes");
      route("home-door-"+n,[[laneX,z],[x-side*3.1,z]],1.5,"cobblestone");
      api.place({assetId:api.asset("supplies",n%2),position:[x-side*3.4,z+2],facing:{target:[laneX,z]},groupId:"homes"});
      n++;
    }
  }
  for (const z of [-25,-13]) {
    for (const x of [-6,6]) {
      building("home",n%3,"中心巷住宅"+n,[x,z],[0,z],[5.4,6.7,6.2],"homes");
      route("home-door-"+n,[[0,z],[x+(x<0?3.1:-3.1),z]],1.4,"cobblestone");
      api.place({assetId:api.asset("supplies",n%2),position:[x+(x<0?3.5:-3.5),z+2],groupId:"homes"});
      n++;
    }
  }
  for (const x of [-6,6]) {
    building("home",n%3,"上巷住宅"+n,[x,23],[x,18],[5.4,6.7,6.2],"homes");
    route("home-door-"+n,[[x,18],[x,19.9]],1.5,"cobblestone");
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("supplies",n%2),position:[x+2,19.5],groupId:"homes"});
    n++;
  }
  for (const side of [-1,1]) {
    for (const z of [-14,-1,12]) {
      const x=side*30;
      building("home",n%3,"坡边住宅"+n,[x,z],[side*25,z],[5.4,6.7,6.2],"slope-homes");
      route("home-door-"+n,[[side*25,z],[x-side*3.1,z]],1.5,"cobblestone");
      api.place({assetId:api.asset("supplies",n%2),position:[x-side*3.4,z+2],groupId:"slope-homes"});
      n++;
    }
  }

  building("hall",0,"广场北侧村民会堂",[0,35],[0,25],[12,9,8],"civic");
  route("hall-approach",[[0,26],[0,31]],3.6,"cobblestone");
  api.surface({id:"hall-court",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-8,27],[8,27],[8,31],[-8,31]]},clearNatural:true});
  for (const x of [-5,5]) {

    api.place({assetId:api.asset("lamp"),position:[x,31],groupId:"civic"});
  }

  building("chapel",0,"东坡礼堂",[21,27],[21,18],[7,10,9],"chapel");
  route("chapel-walk",[[14,18],[21,18],[21,22.5]],2.5,"cobblestone");
  for (const x of [17,25]) {

  building("bakery",0,"西巷公共面包房",[-20,0],[-20,5],[8,5.7,7],"bakery");
  route("bakery-entry",[[-20,5],[-20,3.5]],2.3,"cobblestone");
  for (let i=0;i<2;i++) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("table"),position:[-22+i*4,9],facing:{target:[-20,5]},groupId:"bakery"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("supplies",i),position:[-23+i*6,3.9],groupId:"bakery"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("trough"),position:[-25,6],facing:{target:[-20,5]},groupId:"bakery"});

  api.place({assetId:api.asset("fountain"),position:[-3,5],groupId:"square"});
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("stall",i%2),position:[6,1+i*4],facing:{target:[0,1+i*4]},groupId:"square"});
  }
  for (const z of [0,10]) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("bench"),position:[-6,z],facing:{target:[-3,5]},groupId:"square"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("lamp"),position:[-8,z],groupId:"square"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("tree",1),position:[-8,12],groupId:"square"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("trough"),position:[9,-3],facing:{target:[5,-3]},groupId:"square"});
  route("wash-access",[[12,-7],[10,-4],[8,-3]],1.8,"cobblestone");

  for (const segment of [
    [[-10,15],[-3,15]],[[3,15],[10,15]],
    [[-27,21],[-23,21]],[[16,31],[25,31]],
    [[-10,-3],[-5,-3]]
  ]) {
    const bays=api.subdividePathBySpan({points:segment,span:3,fit:"stretch"});
    for (const bay of bays) {
      api.placeBetween({assetId:api.asset("wall"),start:bay.start,end:bay.end,dimensions:[3,0.85,0.55],spanAxis:"x",groupId:"terrace-edges"});
    }
  }
  api.placeAlongRoute({routeId:main,assetId:api.asset("lamp"),spacing:12,offset:2.6,side:"left",startInset:13,endInset:7,groupId:"street-lights"});
  api.placeAlongRoute({routeId:west,assetId:api.asset("lamp"),spacing:16,offset:1.9,side:"left",startInset:8,endInset:6,groupId:"street-lights"});
  api.placeAlongRoute({routeId:east,assetId:api.asset("lamp"),spacing:16,offset:1.9,side:"right",startInset:8,endInset:6,groupId:"street-lights"});

  api.grass({id:"valley-meadow",preset:"meadow",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-35,-47],[35,-47],[35,40],[-35,40]]},density:0.35,height:0.22,mix:{short:0.8,tall:0.15,flowers:0.05}});
  api.grass({id:"west-mountain",preset:"alpine-moss",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-48,-47],[-35,-47],[-34,46],[-48,46]]},density:0.55,height:0.15});
  api.grass({id:"east-mountain",preset:"alpine-moss",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[35,-47],[48,-47],[48,46],[34,46]]},density:0.55,height:0.15});
  const trees=api.poissonDisk({bounds:{minX:-44,maxX:44,minZ:-43,maxZ:43},minDistance:5.5,maxPoints:150,seed:api.seed});
  let t=0;
  for (const p of trees) {
    if (Math.abs(p[0])>35 || (p[1]<-33 && Math.abs(p[0])>10) || (p[1]>39 && Math.abs(p[0])>16)) {
      api.place({assetId:api.asset(t%3===0?"tree":"pine",t%2),position:[p[0],p[1]],scale:0.75+0.08*(t%5),rotationY:t*0.73,groupId:"valley-woodland"});
      t++;
    }
  }
  for (let i=0;i<14;i++) {
    const side=i%2===0?-1:1;
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("rock",i%2),position:[side*(39+(i%3)*2),-35+Math.floor(i/2)*11],rotationY:i*0.61,scale:0.7+(i%3)*0.2,groupId:"valley-rocks"});
  }
  api.spawn([-3,-39],0);
  api.renderSuggestion("建议柔和的山谷清晨侧光，清晰可读的石墙和板岩屋顶，远坡轻雾；从南侧略高处看见密集屋顶、连续街巷与中央广场，同时保留地面步行视角。照明及最终曝光在单独确认的渲染阶段设置。");

function segmentDistance(x,z,a,b) {
  const dx=b[0]-a[0], dz=b[1]-a[1];
  const den=dx*dx+dz*dz;
  const t=den ? Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-a[0])*dx+(z-a[1])*dz)/den)) : 0;
  return Math.hypot(x-a[0]-t*dx,z-a[1]-t*dz);
}
function roadClearance(x,z) {
  let d=Infinity;
  for (const road of roads) {
    for(let i=1;i<road.points.length;i++) {
      d=Math.min(d,segmentDistance(x,z,road.points[i-1],road.points[i])-road.width/2);
    }
  }
  return d;
}
function available(x,z,r) {
  if(x < -29 || x > 26 || z < -35 || z > 36) return false;
  if(roadClearance(x,z)<r+0.2) return false;
  for(const p of plazas) if(Math.hypot(x-p.x,z-p.z)<r+p.r-0.2) return false;
  for(const o of occupied) if(Math.hypot(x-o.x,z-o.z)<r+o.r+0.35) return false;
  if(x>-5 && x<10 && z>-15 && z<1) return false;
  return true;
}

// Houses are sampled from street edges; each receives its own ground-level approach.
const houseCounts = {house:0,smallHouse:0,tallHouse:0};
const homeRecords = [];
function tryHouse(road, seg, t, side, key, variant, scale) {
  const a=road.points[seg], b=road.points[seg+1];
  const dx=b[0]-a[0], dz=b[1]-a[1], len=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
  if(len<0.1) return false;
  const dims=key==="house" ? [5.2,5.7] : key==="smallHouse" ? [4.5,4.8] : [4.8,5.5];
  const radius=Math.hypot(dims[0],dims[1])*scale/2;
  const px=a[0]+dx*t, pz=a[1]+dz*t;
  const offset=road.width/2+radius+R(0.35,1.1);
  const x=px+dz/len*offset*side, z=pz-dx/len*offset*side;
  if(!available(x,z,radius)) return false;
  const angle=Math.atan2(px-x,pz-z);
  put(key,variant,x,z,angle,scale,radius,"沿巷石屋");
  const entranceX=x+Math.sin(angle)*dims[1]*scale/2;
  const entranceZ=z+Math.cos(angle)*dims[1]*scale/2;
  api.route({
    id:"doorstep-"+homeRecords.length,
    points:[[px,pz],[entranceX,entranceZ]],
    width:1.2, curve:"polyline", surface:"paving"
  });
  homeRecords.push({x,z,angle,scale,dims});
  houseCounts[key]++;
  return true;
}

}

  const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1];

function segmentDistance(x,z,a,b) {
  const dx=b[0]-a[0], dz=b[1]-a[1];
  const denominator=dx*dx+dz*dz;
  const t=denominator ? Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-a[0])*dx+(z-a[1])*dz)/denominator)) : 0;
  return Math.hypot(x-a[0]-t*dx,z-a[1]-t*dz);
}
function roadClearance(x,z) {
  let d=Infinity;
  for (const s of streets) for (let j=1;j<s.points.length;j++) {
    d=Math.min(d,segmentDistance(x,z,s.points[j-1],s.points[j])-s.width/2);
  }
  return d;
}
const occupied=[
  {x:-2,z:-13,r:8.1},
  {x:-13,z:0,r:5.1},
  {x:-2,z:0,r:8.8},
  {x:11,z:30,r:8.2}
];
const houses=[];
let count=0;
for (let attempt=0;attempt<2300 && count<62;attempt++) {
  const si=Math.floor(rand(0,7));
  const s=streets[si];
  const j=Math.floor(rand(1,s.points.length));
  const a=s.points[j-1], b=s.points[j];
  const dx=b[0]-a[0], dz=b[1]-a[1], length=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
  if (length<0.01) continue;
  const t=rand(0.09,0.91);
  const side=Math.random()<0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  const small=count%4===1;
  const scale=rand(0.86,1.08);
  const radius=(small ? 3.3 : 3.8)*scale;
  const offset=s.width/2+radius+rand(0.35,1.4);
  const px=a[0]+dx*t, pz=a[1]+dz*t;
  const x=px+side*dz/length*offset;
  const z=pz-side*dx/length*offset;
  if (Math.abs(x)>31 || z < -28 || z>35) continue;
  if (roadClearance(x,z)<radius+0.15) continue;
  if (occupied.some(o=>Math.hypot(x-o.x,z-o.z)<radius+o.r+0.35)) continue;
  const yaw=Math.atan2(px-x,pz-z);
  const key=small?'cottage':'home';
  put(key,x,z,yaw,scale,small?Math.floor(count/4)%2:count%3);
  occupied.push({x,z,r:radius});
  houses.push({x,z,yaw,scale,small});
  const halfDepth=(small?2.25:2.7)*scale;
  const front=[x+Math.sin(yaw)*halfDepth,z+Math.cos(yaw)*halfDepth];
  api.route({
    id:'door-'+count,name:'入户石径',points:[[px,pz],front],
    width:1.15,curve:'polyline',surface:'paving'
  });
  count++;
}

// Small domestic details remain against walls, away from the public routes.
for (let i=0;i<houses.length;i+=5) {
  const h=houses[i];
  const distance=(h.small?2.5:2.8)*h.scale;
  const x=h.x+Math.cos(h.yaw)*distance;
  const z=h.z-Math.sin(h.yaw)*distance;
  if (roadClearance(x,z)>1.2) put('wood',x,z,h.yaw,0.8);
}

// Dense woodland shoulders enclose the village; the southern mouth stays open.
const trees=[];
for (let k=0;k<420;k++) {
  const x=rand(-44,44), z=rand(-44,43);
  const shoulder=Math.abs(x)>32;
  const rear=z < -33;
  if (!shoulder && !rear) continue;
  if (x>-12 && x<15 && z>-2) continue;
  if (roadClearance(x,z)<3.5) continue;
  if (trees.some(p=>Math.hypot(x-p[0],z-p[1])<rand(3.3,5))) continue;
  if (Math.sin(x*0.19+z*0.13)>0.7 && Math.random()<0.72) continue;
  const pine=Math.abs(x)>37 || z<-37;
  put(pine?'pine':'tree',x,z,rand(0,Math.PI*2),rand(0.72,1.25),trees.length%2);
  trees.push([x,z]);
}
for (let i=0;i<24;i++) {
  const side=i%2 ? 1 : -1;
  const x=side*rand(34,44), z=rand(-39,38);
  if (roadClearance(x,z)<3) continue;

  api.surface({id:'outcrop-soil-'+i,surface:'rock',region:circle(x,z,rand(2.1,3.6)),intensity:0.65});
}

    if (horizontal) {

      splitRegion({ x: region.x + cut + 0.8, z: region.z, w: region.w - cut - 0.8, d: region.d }, depth - 1, out);
    } else {
      splitRegion({ x: region.x, z: region.z, w: region.w, d: cut - 0.8 }, depth - 1, out);
      splitRegion({ x: region.x, z: region.z + cut + 0.8, w: region.w, d: region.d - cut - 0.8 }, depth - 1, out);
    }
  }

function segmentDistance(p, a, b) {
  const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1];
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p[0] - a[0]) * dx + (p[1] - a[1]) * dz) / Math.max(0.0001, dx * dx + dz * dz)));

function frontage(frame) {

  const radius = 3.65 * scale;
  if (!available(p, radius)) return [];
  const key = tall ? "tallhouse" : "house";
  const variant = tall ? Math.floor(houseCount / 5) % 2 : houseCount % 3;
  put(key, p, frame.a, scale, variant, tall ? "坡地窄楼" : "石砌住宅");
  reserve(p, radius);
  const door = [p[0] + Math.sin(frame.a) * 3 * scale, p[1] + Math.cos(frame.a) * 3 * scale];
  const foot = [frame.foot[0], frame.foot[1]];

  houseCount++;

function across(fragment, road) {
  const output = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < road.points.length; i++) {
    const a = road.points[i - 1], b = road.points[i];
    const len = distance(a, b);
    if (len < 0.1) continue;
    const dx = (b[0] - a[0]) / len, dz = (b[1] - a[1]) / len;
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      for (let t = rand(0.8, 3.1); t < len; t += rand(5.6, 7.5)) {
        const foot = [a[0] + dx * t, a[1] + dz * t];
        const scale = rand(0.79, 1.02);
        const offset = road.width / 2 + 3.7 * scale + rand(0.2, 0.75);
        const p = [foot[0] + dz * side * offset, foot[1] - dx * side * offset];
        output.push(...fragment({
          x: p[0], z: p[1], a: Math.atan2(foot[0] - p[0], foot[1] - p[1]),
          s: scale, foot
        }));
      }
    }
  }
  return output;
}

    while (walked < len) {

        });

function distanceToSegment(p, a, b) {
  const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1];
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p[0] - a[0]) * dx + (p[1] - a[1]) * dz) / (dx * dx + dz * dz || 1)));

}
function roadClear(p, radius) {
  for (const street of streets) {
    for (let i = 1; i < street.points.length; i++) {
      if (distanceToSegment(p, street.points[i - 1], street.points[i]) < radius + street.width / 2 + 0.55) return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}
function free(p, radius) {
  if (p[0] < -31 || p[0] > 26 || p[1] < -38 || p[1] > 40) return false;
  if (!roadClear(p, radius)) return false;
  return occupied.every(o => Math.hypot(p[0] - o.p[0], p[1] - o.p[1]) > radius + o.r + 0.28);
}
function streetFront(street, side, offset) {
  const homes = [];
  let walked = offset;
  for (let i = 1; i < street.points.length; i++) {
    const a = street.points[i - 1], b = street.points[i];
    const length = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]);
    const dx = (b[0] - a[0]) / length, dz = (b[1] - a[1]) / length;
    while (walked < length) {
      const anchor = [a[0] + dx * walked, a[1] + dz * walked];
      const small = Math.random() < 0.35;
      const size = small ? rand(0.83, 1) : rand(0.8, 0.97);
      const radius = (small ? 3.2 : 3.98) * size;
      const setback = street.width / 2 + radius + rand(0.7, 1.35);
      const p = [anchor[0] + dz * side * setback, anchor[1] - dx * side * setback];
      if (free(p, radius)) {
        const rotation = Math.atan2(anchor[0] - p[0], anchor[1] - p[1]);
        put(small ? "small" : "house", p, rotation, size);
        occupied.push({ p, r: radius });
        const doorDistance = (small ? 2.3 : 2.9) * size;
        const front = [p[0] + Math.sin(rotation) * doorDistance, p[1] + Math.cos(rotation) * doorDistance];
        api.route({

        homes.push({ center: p, front, lane: anchor });

    }
    walked -= length;
  }
  return homes;
}

    result.push(...fragment(f, 1, rand(2.8, 4.8)));

  return result;
}

function plan(api) {

  const smooth = (a, b, x) => {
    const t = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
    return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
  };
  const falloff = (x, z, cx, cz, r) => {
    const d = Math.hypot(x - cx, z - cz);
    return 1 - smooth(r * 0.55, r, d);
  };

    const a = Math.sin(x * 0.15 + z * 0.035);
    const b = Math.sin(z * 0.21 - x * 0.06);

  };

    const village = falloff(x, z, 5, 3, 29);
    const terraces = 0.55 + 0.45 * ridge(x, z);
    const slope = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin((x + z) * 0.12);
    const openness = smooth(0.22, 0.72, 0.55 * terraces + 0.45 * slope);

function wetness(x, z) {
  return Math.exp(-Math.pow((x - 35 - 2 * Math.sin(z / 13)) / 15, 2));
}
function population(x, z) {

function prominence(x, z) {
  return -z * 0.025 + 0.22 * Math.cos(x / 15) - 0.2 * wetness(x, z);
}

function subdivide(r, depth, side) {

    subdivide({...r, x0: x, name: r.name + "东"}, depth + 1, side + 4);

}

    prompt: "A narrow square stone watchtower on a mountain slope, with a timber lookout platform, small roof, and signal lantern. Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance direction, X+ is right.",
    dimensions: [4.5, 11, 4.5],
    role: "structure",
    variants: 1
  });

  api.requireAsset({
    key: "village_fountain",
    name: "石泉",
    prompt: "A low round carved stone fountain with a clear central spring, shallow basin, and moss along its rim. Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance direction, X+ is right.",
    dimensions: [3.5, 1.5, 3.5],
    role: "environment",
    variants: 1
  });

  api.requireAsset({
    key: "wood_pine",
    name: "山地松树",
    prompt: "A single rugged alpine pine tree with a slightly wind shaped crown, exposed roots, and natural asymmetry. Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance direction, X+ is right.",
    dimensions: [3.5, 9, 3.5],
    role: "environment",
    variants: 2
  });

  const houseA = api.asset("stone_house", 0);
  const houseB = api.asset("stone_house", 1);
  const hall = api.asset("village_hall", 0);
  const shelter = api.asset("market_shelter", 0);
  const tower = api.asset("watchtower", 0);
  const fountain = api.asset("village_fountain", 0);
  const pineA = api.asset("wood_pine", 0);
  const pineB = api.asset("wood_pine", 1);

  api.place({ assetId: hall, name: "村民会堂", position: [1, 8], rotationY: 0.15, scale: 1.05, role: "structure" });
  api.place({ assetId: shelter, name: "谷地集市", position: [4, 8], rotationY: 1.15, scale: 0.92, role: "structure" });
  api.place({ assetId: fountain, name: "公共泉池", position: [1, 7], rotationY: 0, scale: 1, role: "environment" });
  api.place({ assetId: tower, name: "东坡瞭望塔", position: [24, 2], rotationY: -0.65, scale: 1, role: "structure" });

  const houseSites = [
    [-31, 19, 1.0], [-27, 16, 0.9], [-22, 20, 1.05], [-18, 16, 0.92],
    [-13, 12, 1.0], [-8, 15, 0.88], [-3, 18, 1.08], [8, 13, 0.95],
    [13, 9, 1.0], [18, 7, 0.9], [22, 3, 1.04], [27, -1, 0.93],
    [-26, 5, 0.86], [-20, 2, 1.0], [-14, -3, 0.92], [-8, -5, 1.05],
    [4, -10, 0.9], [10, -14, 0.98], [17, -17, 0.88], [24, -13, 1.0],
    [29, -19, 0.92], [34, -22, 0.86]
  ];

  for (let i = 0; i < houseSites.length; i++) {
    const s = houseSites[i];
    const p = [jitter(s[0], 1.3), jitter(s[1], 1.1)];
    const nearMain = i < 12;
    const facing = nearMain ? angleAt(mainStreet, (i + 1) / 14) : angleAt(lowerStreet, (i - 10) / 14);
    api.place({
      assetId: i % 3 === 0 ? houseB : houseA,
      name: "石屋住宅",
      position: p,
      rotationY: facing + (i % 2 ? Math.PI : 0),
      scale: s[2] * (0.92 + Math.random() * 0.14),
      role: "structure"
    });
  }

  const pineSites = [
    [-39, 28], [-34, 32], [-28, 29], [-18, 27], [-8, 25],
    [12, 20], [20, 15], [30, 10], [38, 4], [-38, -4],
    [-30, -8], [-22, -12], [29, -28], [37, -31], [43, -13]
  ];

  for (let i = 0; i < pineSites.length; i++) {
    const p = [jitter(pineSites[i][0], 2.2), jitter(pineSites[i][1], 2.0)];
    if (inside(p)) {
      api.place({
        assetId: i % 2 ? pineB : pineA,
        name: "山地松树",
        position: p,
        rotationY: Math.random() * R,
        scale: 0.78 + Math.random() * 0.45,
        role: "environment"
      });
    }
  }
}
